description: This trail is over 40km long, travelling north and west from Burns Lake towards Palling - intersecting with the Nellian Lake Trail enroute. Parts of the trail use existing resource roads, and this trail is available to ATV use in summer. Please be wary of industrial traffic and avoid environmental damage to wet areas.
directions: Turn up Babine Lake Road from Burns Lake Village, travel ~13km to the entrance of Burns Lake Snowmobile Club staging area on left.

stats.Activity Details: Hiking, Ski Touring, Trail Bike Riding - Motorized, Snowmobiling

title: Burns Lake Snowmobile club Trail
